payload.title: Chapter 2: a joint dies mid-task
payload.task: Put the red cube in the green target zone.

payload.text: I'll start by reading the scene description to learn the workcell layout and conventions.

result.text:
Workcell: a Franka Emika Panda arm (7 revolute joints, parallel-jaw gripper) mounted at the world origin on a table whose top surface is z = 0.
World frame: origin at the robot base, +x points away from the robot, +y to the robot's left, +z up. Units are metres, radians and seconds; quaternions are [w, x, y, z]. Arm joints are indexed 0..6 (joint1..joint7).

Objects:
- red cube, 4 cm on each side (half-size 0.02), 50 g. Resting on the table its centre is at z = 0.02. It starts near [0.50, 0.00, 0.02].
- green target zone, a flat 12 x 12 cm square centred at [0.50, -0.25, 0.001] (half-size [0.06, 0.06, 0.001]). It has no collision.
Task success: the cube rests on the table (centre z < 0.03, nearly still) with its centre within 0.05 m horizontally of the zone centre, and the gripper is open and not touching it.

End effector: every position refers to the tool centre point (TCP), the point midway between the fingertip pads, 0.1034 m beyond the hand flange. Omitting quat (or passing null) uses the default top-down orientation [0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0]: fingers pointing straight down, closing along world y. The gripper opens to 0.08 m between the pads; the cube is 0.04 m wide. To grasp, open the gripper, put the TCP at the cube centre (z = 0.02) and close; `holding` becomes true when both fingers touch the cube. Approach from above (about 0.12 m above the cube) and descend vertically so the fingers do not hit the cube.

Motion:
- move_ee: straight-line TCP motion to the target over duration_s (default 2 s), inverse kinematics on the 7 arm joints at every waypoint. Joints listed in excluded_joints are held at their current angle and the IK uses only the others. Returns reached = true when the final TCP position error is below 0.015 m, plus the error, the final TCP pose and the per-joint tracking error (commanded minus actual angle).
- move_joints: joint-space motion to 7 angles. Limits (rad): joint1 +/-2.90, joint2 +/-1.76, joint3 +/-2.90, joint4 -3.07..-0.07, joint5 +/-2.90, joint6 -0.02..3.75, joint7 +/-2.90.
- set_gripper: "open" or "close" (about 0.5 s).
- wait: let the simulation run (the arm holds its last command).
Comfortable top-down workspace: x 0.30..0.70, y -0.35..0.35, z 0.02..0.40 (keep the TCP within about 0.75 m of the base). TCP targets below z = 0.01 are rejected: the fingertips reach 0.009 m below the TCP.

Sensing:
- get_state: joint angles/velocities/targets, TCP pose, gripper opening and target, contacts (how many fingers touch the cube, whether the cube touches the table) and object poses from the object tracker (objects.cube; null if the tracker reports nothing).
- locate_object: finds an object by colour ("red" = cube, "green" = zone) in a camera image by colour segmentation and back-projects its image centroid onto the table, assuming the object rests on the table. The default camera "top" looks straight down from [0.5, -0.1, 1.2]; the arm can hide objects beneath it, so move the arm aside if the object is not found.
- render: camera image. "front" = overview from the front-left, "top" = straight down (image up = +x, image right = -y), "wrist" = on the hand, looking along the fingers.
- diagnose: per-joint commanded vs actual angle and velocity, sensor status, last move result and a plain-English list of anomalies.
- check_task: evaluates the success criteria above.

payload.text: The scene is clear: cube near [0.50, 0.00, 0.02], zone at [0.50, -0.25]; now I'll read the live state to get actual positions.
Tracker reports the cube at [0.50, 0.00, 0.02] and the gripper is already open (0.08 m), so I'll move to pre-grasp 0.12 m above the cube at [0.50, 0.00, 0.14].
Pre-grasp reached with 0 mm error; I'll re-confirm the cube position before descending.
Cube is unchanged at [0.50, 0.00, 0.02]; descending vertically to grasp height z = 0.02.
Reached at z = 0.02 with 3.6 mm error, though joint 0 shows a -0.0071 rad tracking error (TCP 3.6 mm off in y), which I'll watch; closing the gripper now.
Grasp is good (opening 0.0396 m, holding = true); lifting straight up to z = 0.20.
Lift reached z = 0.20, but joint 0 has lagged its command by ~0.0072 rad on two moves in a row, and the transport needs a large joint-0 rotation, so I'll run diagnose first.
Diagnose reports no anomalies; joint 0 isn't flagged frozen, though its angle has stayed at 0.0073 rad. I'll do the transport to [0.50, -0.25, 0.20] and check closely whether joint 0 follows.

result.note: target NOT reached: the TCP stopped 14.4 cm from the target; joints not following their commands: index 0 (commanded -0.250, actual +0.007 rad)

payload.text: The transport failed: the TCP stopped 14.4 cm short, and joint 0 is stuck at +0.007 rad while commanded −0.250 rad. I'll run diagnose to confirm before I re-plan.

result.summary: joint index 0 (joint1) is not following its command: commanded -0.250 rad, actual +0.007 rad, and it did not move during the last move (suspected frozen); last move missed its target by 14.4 cm

payload.text: Diagnose confirms joint 0 is frozen at +0.0073 rad, and the cube is still held (2 finger contacts). I'll retry the transport with joint 0 excluded, and keep it excluded from here on.
With joint 0 excluded, the arm reached the spot above the zone (0.1 mm error). Descending to z = 0.03 with joint 0 still excluded.
Reached z = 0.03 over the zone centre (0.1 mm error); opening the gripper to release the cube.
The gripper is open (0.0796 m) and the cube is released; retreating straight up to z = 0.20 with joint 0 still excluded.
The retreat reached z = 0.20 with 0 mm error; now running check_task to verify the success criteria.

result.reason: the cube rests in the target zone and the gripper has released it

payload.text: check_task reports success, with the cube 1.8 mm from the zone centre. I'll render the front camera to confirm it visually.
In the image, the red cube sits near the centre of the green zone, and the open gripper hangs well above it without touching. I'll log the outcome.

payload.summary: I picked up the red cube at [0.50, 0.00] and placed it in the green zone; check_task confirms success, with the cube at [0.502, -0.250], 1.8 mm from the zone centre, and the gripper open. Joint 0 (joint1) froze at about +0.007 rad. It first showed as a small lag during the descent, then caused the transport move to stop 14.4 cm short of its target. Diagnose confirmed joint 0 as suspected frozen, so I retried the transport with joint 0 excluded and kept it excluded for every later move, and all of them reached within 0.1 mm. The grasp held throughout, and the front camera shows the cube centred in the zone with the gripper clear above it.

payload.text:
The red cube is in the green target zone. It sits 1.8 mm from the zone centre and check_task passed.

**Problem: joint 0 (the base joint) froze at about +0.007 rad.** It first showed as a small lag of 0.007 rad while lowering to grab the cube. That cost only 3.6 mm, so I picked up the cube and lifted it. The move over to the zone then stopped 14.4 cm short because that move needs the base joint to turn. Diagnose confirmed joint 0 was frozen, and the cube was still held.

**Fix:** I retried the move with joint 0 locked in place, so the other six joints did the work. I kept it locked for the lowering, release and lift-off moves too, and each of those reached within 0.1 mm.

The front camera shows the cube near the middle of the green square, with the open gripper above it and not touching it. I logged the outcome as a success.

Joint 0 is still frozen, so the arm needs checking before its next job. Without that joint the arm can't turn at the base, so it can reach less of the table.

detail.reason: the cube rests in the target zone and the gripper has released it
